newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI says to take majority control of AG&P.
newsitem.headline: DMCI says to take majority control of AG&P.

text.p: Construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc (DMCI) plans to take a 51 percent stake in Atlantic Gulf & Pacific Company of Manila Inc (AG&P), a unit of AGP Industrial Corp (AGPI), DMCI and AGPI said.

In a joint statement submitted to the Philippine Stock Exchange on Friday, the two firms said DMCI has agreed to invest 200 million pesos in new shares of AG&P which will represent between 15 to 30 percent of its total oustanding capital.
